name: proto-forge
description: The proto-forge skills and their app templates. This package holds the plugin-level gates only; every generated app has its own package.json under its template's dir in references/templates.json.

scripts.test: pnpm run selftest && pnpm run verify
scripts.verify: pnpm run citations && pnpm run skill:lint && pnpm run skill:gates && pnpm run manifest:lint && pnpm run models:lint && pnpm run security:catalogue && pnpm run template:integrity && pnpm run deploy:sync && pnpm run discovery:lint && pnpm run survey:lint && pnpm run elicit:lint
